primary: SHIP-Trend sex-specific q25, median, q75 and age coefficients; SHIP-0 diagnostics retained as temporal sensitivity, not selection targets.
adequacy: Require all three source executions and verifications. Across the three seeds, each primary quantile mean discrepancy must have absolute value <=0.20 percentage points and each primary per-year age slope mean discrepancy <=0.004. These are pragmatic engineering thresholds, not confidence intervals or scientific validation.
revision: If inadequate, investigate all checks. Only coherent same-direction median errors >0.10 across all seeds permit a source-median offset correction (maximum 0.20). Same-direction IQR errors >0.15 across all seeds permit residual scale correction. Do not alter evidence-supported age slopes to optimize approximate source sampling. Do not optimize BMI assumptions using marginal source fit.
selection: Select the earliest adequate model. Freeze a final retain revision binding actual feedback if initial is adequate. If no model is adequate within the allowed revisions, select the earliest version with the smallest maximum absolute primary quantile mean discrepancy, disclose lack of adequacy, and retain every slope/sensitivity discrepancy. Failed execution is not adequate. No target outcome or reserved analysis participates.
